title: Chapter 415 Copper Hammer Master
content:
Chapter 415 Copper Hammer Master

After Dongfang Ling left, Wang Shuo also hurried to Shanhai City.

When Zhu Dongheng heard Wang Shuo talking about the alliance, he immediately said: "This is a good thing. It can greatly reduce our pressure."

"I also agree with forming an alliance, but we still have to take precautions. Even if we have allies, we cannot take it lightly."

"That's natural. Before the barrier disappears completely, we must do our best to improve our military strength."

After the three people discussed it, Wang Shuo and Zhao Bond returned to the territory together.

They came to the resource exchange stone together.

When it comes to understanding the resource exchange stone, Zhao Bonde is the most knowledgeable.

The resource exchange stone has been deeply developed by Wang Shuo, Zhao Bangde and others.

It has reached the point where it can be exchanged for a high-level general's job transfer certificate.

Zhao Bondang knew that as long as the Dahuai Territory was completely connected to the outside world and the resources were exchanged for stones, they would disappear.

Therefore, you must seize this last opportunity and redeem as many useful things as possible.

The general's job transfer certificate is undoubtedly a very cost-effective thing.

In addition, tool man is also a good choice.

Wang Shuo continued to exchange tools for people from the resource exchange office to replenish his manpower.

At the same time, the original middle-level officers were transferred to military generals.

He also called all the commanders together.

"I hope that in two months, you will all be able to become warrior generals." Wang Shuo had already distributed the promotion pills to them, and also took out a large number of pills.

In the subsequent wars, without the strength of the generals, I am afraid they will only become cannon fodder.

Just as Wang Shuo continued to improve the strength of Wana City, half a month passed in the blink of an eye.

On this day, Hadro teleported over with Master Bronze Hammer.

Master Bronze Hammer has a long beard, his arms are as thick as an ordinary person's thighs, and a giant hammer hangs from his waist.

Wang Shuo felt his aura and found out that he was a high-level warrior.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but stand in awe.

Not simple!

"You just want to create a Shura suit?"

Master Bronze Hammer asked curiously, while his eyes kept wandering around Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo felt very uncomfortable under Master Bronze Hammer's gaze, but he still said bravely: "That's right."

"What is the title of Shura you received?"

"Red Eyes."

"Do you know the function of the Shura title?"

Wang Shuo was shocked. Does the title still have any effect?

He doesn't know this.

"I just received the title not long ago, and I haven't heard about it yet."

Master Bronze Hammer laughed: "You kid, you don't think you can ask me for just three feathers! To be honest, I only agreed to build this set of equipment for you because of the reputation of the Shura title."

"Remember in the future, when others ask who built your equipment, remember to give me my name."

Wang Shuo naturally said yes.

"When the Shura suit is finished, you will know what your title is and what it does."

Immediately, Wang Shuo brought Master Bronze Hammer to the blacksmith shop in his territory.

When the blacksmiths saw a master-level blacksmith, their hearts felt like a storm.

Matar even prostrated himself on the ground, his heart full of piety.

"Welcome Master Bronze Hammer, I will be honored in this life, and I will die without regrets!"

Wang Shuo found it difficult to understand Matar's behavior.

He did not expect that a master-level blacksmith would have such a distinguished status.

Master Bronze Hammer heard this and looked at Matar: "Have you heard of me?"

"The reputation of the Grandmaster is like thunder piercing my ears!"

Wang Shuo was shocked. In his mind, Matar never flattered anyone.

"Very good, I just need a helper, it's you!"

Matar was so happy that he didn't know where to put his hands.
